prompt: Which player has the third-highest goals-per-match ratio among the top 15 all-time goalscorers in UEFA European Championship history?
answer:
**Alan Shearer** — he scored **7 goals in 9 matches**, a ratio of **0.78 goals per match**.

Among the top 15 all-time Euro scorers, only **Michel Platini (1.80)** and **Patrik Schick (0.86)** rank higher by goals-per-match ratio.
